groups.defect: In the AccessTokenContext constructor, grantType is null-checked twice and rawTokenId is never checked, because the second requireNonNull uses grantType by mistake.
groups.rationale: All four point at the same copy-paste requireNonNull error on the same lines and propose the same one-line fix.

groups.defect: The isAccessTokenId matcher reads the grant shortcut from the wrong offset (substring(3,5) instead of (4,6)) and its equality check is inverted, so it does not validate the grant shortcut correctly.
groups.rationale: All five report the same wrong offset and the same inverted check in the same matcher. A few also suggest a length guard, which is part of the same fix.

groups.defect: OAuth2GrantType.Context throws an NPE in the constructor when formParams is null, keeps a stale cached grantType after setFormParams(), and no longer has its copy constructor.
groups.rationale: s_f886b821 reports both the NPE (shared with s_611afbf2) and the stale grantType (shared with s_ce1639a8), so the three overlap in a chain on the same Context code.
